summary: IHS Holding Limited filed a Form 6-K announcing the completion of the sale of its 51% stake in I-Systems Soluções de Infraestrutura S.A., a shared optical fiber networks provider in Brazil, to TIM S.A., which owned the remaining 49%. Terms were not disclosed in the filing; the sale was initially announced on February 11, 2026. J.P. Morgan acted as financial advisor to IHS Towers. The transaction closed on May 7, 2026. For the risk-arb angle, monitor any earn-out provisions or regulatory adjustments in Brazil, though the completion with no material conditions suggests low execution risk.
